entries.source: If you are reading it in the future, you are probably from a nother crew. The turnover rate here is enormous, maybe cause this job sucks and every one turns over dead! Maybe I can give some help when I have some expirience. End log
entries.target: 如果未来有人读到这段，大概也是另一个船员小队吧。这里换人快得吓人，可能是因为这工作烂透了，而且大家最后都翻成死人！等我有点经验，也许能留点帮助。日志结束

entries.source: They made ME< put the baby bird on the desk. I think I shouldn't have done it. i know why they made me do it now.... theyre even more guilty than i am. cowards. So i went and told it to desmond's face. Do your own dirty work.
entries.target: 他们让“我”把那只小鸟放到柜台上。我觉得我不该那么做。现在我知道他们为什么让我来做了……他们比我更心虚。懦夫。所以我当面告诉 Desmond：自己的脏活自己干。

entries.source: I will hand in my letter of resignation personally. It’s time to see who we've been working for. No, Sigurd, this is not our real job. Our work has just begun. And there is no way out but further in.
entries.target: 我会亲手递交辞职信。是时候看看我们到底在为谁工作了。不，Sigurd，这不是我们真正的工作。我们的工作才刚刚开始。没有退路，只有继续深入。

entries.source: date is August 31, 1968. i got camera duty again, i hate walking on this moon anyway. ahah jokes on them it, just started raining!!! Im just sitting. cant sleep on these tiny beds for ants
entries.target: 日期是 1968 年 8 月 31 日。我又被安排看监视器，反正我也讨厌在这颗卫星上走路。哈哈，笑死他们，刚开始下雨了！！！我就坐着。这些蚂蚁床小得根本睡不着

entries.target:
这几天我们算是“进入节奏”了。Rich 总这么说，他闻起来像一罐馊掉的金枪鱼。这是我参加过最糟的夏令营。哦……日期是 1968 年 8 月 27 日。
我们确保总有人带着铲子，好去砸任何会动的东西；也总会安排一个人“看监视器”，这样他们就能打开这些带字母和数字的大安全门。问问 Desmond 那个巫师这是怎么运作的吧，我觉得他只是把门上的代码敲进去。就这样。

今天我们卖了些东西给公司。我听着柜台后面那些疯疯癫癫的声音，紧张得发冷。别人倒是一点不在乎。？？
我的手电光甚至照不到那后面，光束直接变暗了。

entries.source:
date: September 18, 1968
the past weekend it feels like Desmond and Jess woke up. we;re supposed to get our fourth member of the crew in a few days. We arent taking any risks anymore, we dont get as much but it feels safer, and ive gotten better sleep. but its still ass. i can still smell Rich i swear to gosh he smelled that bad


i was talking about how the voice on the phone sounded fake. Then Desmond got this weird idea. he's the wizard and all so he thinks theres a way to use the phone call i made to the company number to find ourt where the voice comes from. i dont know why hed want to do that but he seems serious. He;s been using the terminal a lot.
entries.target:
日期：1968 年 9 月 18 日
过去这个周末，感觉 Desmond 和 Jess 终于醒过来了。再过几天我们应该会迎来第四名船员。我们不再冒任何风险，虽然拿到的东西少了点，但感觉更安全，我也睡得更好了。可这里还是烂。我发誓我还能闻到 Rich 的臭味，他就是那么臭。


我当时在说电话里的声音听起来很假。然后 Desmond 想到了一个怪主意。他是那个巫师之类的，所以他觉得有办法利用我打给公司号码的那通电话，查出声音到底来自哪里。我不知道他为什么想这么做，但他看起来很认真。他最近一直在用终端。

entries.source: this suit is squeezing me like I'm a gosh damn mummy! im a grown man, give it some space between the legs! it's killing me i'm dying! i FINALLY got a job, and its just like dad always said. Everyone here smells. especially Rich. I'm going to throw him in the lake. I don't care what it's made of. i love being on screen duty. oh
entries.target: 这套制服把我勒得像个该死的木乃伊！我是个成年人，裆那里给我留点空间！它要杀了我，我快死了！我终于找到一份工作了，结果就像爸爸一直说的那样。这里每个人都臭。尤其是 Rich。我要把他扔进湖里。我不管那湖是什么做的。我喜欢看监视器。哦

Thats it

It was the same fake voice i remember from the interview on the phone at home and the stupid training videos. but it heard what i said i think, cause it said they would contact the family and find a replacement and something e lse. It talked so fast

entries.source:
I talked ot a voice on the walkie talkie, it was like a part of the pestle and morter. he told me the Golden planet actually existed, its not a legend. and he told me it didn't just hit a meteor. He said the planet was swallowed up by the "beast", and they were in its body being diggested. i asked what the beast is, and he said he didnt know!. he said it ate the planet and they forgot everything. \r
\r
i couldnt get him to stop talking. but i said he was on the other side of a big wall and i could get him out. i said he was inside the building. and thats when he started freaking out/. i couldn't make out a word, I think he said something about "spitting out the rinds" So i just turned it off. what a wack
\r
Jess says the golden planet is just a story. I said  I KNOW, I'm not an idiot. Well she said i should quit, and she quits if i do. so shes staying
entries.target:
我用对讲机和一个声音说话，它听起来像杵和臼的一部分。他告诉我黄金星球真的存在，不是传说。他还告诉我，它不是被陨石砸中的。他说那颗星球被“野兽”吞掉了，而他们在它的身体里被消化。我问那头野兽是什么，他说他不知道！他说它吃掉了那颗星球，然后他们忘记了一切。

我没法让他停下。但我说他在一堵大墙的另一边，而我能把他弄出来。我说他在大楼里面。然后他就开始崩溃。我听不清他说的任何一句话，我觉得他说了什么“吐出果皮”之类的。所以我直接关掉了。真是疯子。

Jess 说黄金星球只是个故事。我说我知道，我又不是白痴。然后她说我该辞职，如果我辞她也辞。所以她还留着。

entries.source: desmond wants me to writ e down what we figured out and keep my "nonsense to a minimum". So im going to put SO MUCH of my non sense. screw him. The new crew member is named Lucas and he is so confused and scared a ll the time, what a baby, at least he doesnt smell like a monster. its been so sunny even though its september, and these suits dont take it well
entries.target: Desmond 想让我把我们弄明白的东西写下来，还让我“少写废话”。所以我要写超多废话。去他的。新船员叫 Lucas，他一直又困惑又害怕，真是个小宝宝，至少他闻起来不像怪物。虽然已经九月了，太阳还是很晒，这些制服根本扛不住

entries.source: i started wondering how i cant remember how we really got here, no I just remember little things like the shuttle flight to the building where we signed our contracts. But i dont remember getting on the shuttle, i dont even remember saying bye to dad. sometmies i feel this deep pit in my stomache and i have to think just to remember my name. in my dreams it feels like the company isnt trapped in there at all, its just hiding. I dont know if were going home
entries.target: 我开始纳闷，为什么我想不起自己到底是怎么来到这里的。不，我只记得一些零碎片段，比如坐穿梭机去那栋签合同的大楼。但我不记得自己上了穿梭机，甚至不记得有没有和爸爸道别。有时候我胃里会突然陷下去，必须努力想，才想得起自己的名字。在梦里，公司根本不像被困在那里，它只是躲在那里。我不知道我们还能不能回家

entries.source: were out of snacks and lemonade packets again. desmond thinks stun grenades are "more benefficial and economic" well if he puts off ordering my stuff for another day, im going to take a crap on the control lever and ask him what he thinks about his stun grenades then. desmond dont read this
entries.target: 零食和柠檬粉又没了。Desmond 觉得震撼手雷“更有利也更经济”。好吧，如果他再拖一天不订我的东西，我就要在控制杆上拉屎，然后问问他对他的震撼手雷有什么看法。Desmond 别看这段

entries.source: i know im not the wizard but I guess im the computer guy again today. every time i go outside on vow they say i get pale like im dead, so they put me on screen duty. they think i got soft or something. whatever, Mr. Doofus Lucas is the scared one. good luck keeping him from losing his freaking mind. I could stroll out at night like its my back yard!! Its just that i saw Rich on a hill. he was over on the orther side of the river. but that was three days ago. Im not scared, its just getting cold outside. i think they jus twant me to have screen duty every day now, and they all got an excuse
entries.target: 我知道我不是那个巫师，但今天看来我又是电脑员了。每次我到 Vow 外面，他们都说我脸色白得像死人，所以就让我看监视器。他们觉得我变软弱了什么的。随便吧，蠢蛋 Lucas 才是害怕的那个。祝他们好运，别让他彻底发疯。我晚上都能像在自家后院一样走出去！！只是我在山上看见了 Rich。他在河的另一边。但那已经是三天前了。我不是害怕，只是外面越来越冷。我觉得他们现在只是想让我每天都看监视器，而且每个人都有借口

October 10th 1968


I havent felt like writing. no time. but last night I swear i heard dad talking to me from the vent, the one under the charger. i dont feel crazy. Man, thats what they all say, yea yea i know! Well, im writing this log to keep myself sane, right? so ill write about it. he was asking where he was, breathing really deep like he couldnt breath, like he was getting pulled into the engine. he sounded scared. he said he was thirsty


i never heard dad like that. maybe i just dont get enugh sleep. jeesh, how am i gona do it now. maybe i should just open the thing up and look.


maybe its cause Im feeling bad, cause we sold the baby bird we stole from that giant wingless one that's always stink-eyeing us on Vow. Man it could run thouggh, we had to leave on the spot, and Mr. Doofus Lucas has been chattering his teeth ever since. im not doing that again.
They made ME< put the baby bird on the desk. I think I shouldn't have done it. i know why they made me do it now.... theyre even more guilty than i am. cowards. So i went and told it to desmond's face. Do your own dirty work.

He went all dumb and and said guilty what? For selling the baby bird egg!Then, i cant belive it, he said it's no different than the eggs you eat for breakfast. i said it BROKE OUT AND LOOKED AT US, and i wouldnt eat that! it was ALIVE. And then, what he said. "could it carry scrap? could it get us to the quota? could it raise our efficiency and throughputt and enhance our team synergy, could it bla bla blablablablablblblabalblbalabalbla
blasbdalsbdabdalbalbdalbdlaslbdaldbalbsdlbadlbalbsdlbadlbalbsdlbadlbalsbdabldbasbalsbalbblBSLABALBBALBALBALBASLBASBABBLABSLDBAKDSJAFBSfkjhbaglsdsjbkabdA BLA BLA BLA BL AB LABL A BLA BLA BB LLABDLAB BLAL Abldblbdbd" His fat stupid lips kept flabbibng out like the voice in the company phone. Then he just heaved a big breath like he was satisfied and went back to work, like he won the argument. ill kill him!! desmond why don't i put you on the desk, like I KNOW you all did to Rich. that'll show you team synergy.

i poured some grape juice in thtrough the vent. im so stupid, i dont know why. it wasnt much. i guess i just thought it wont hurt anything

1968 年 10 月 10 日


我一直不想写。没时间。但昨晚我发誓，我听见爸爸在和我说话，声音从充电器下面那个通风口里传出来。我不觉得自己疯了。好吧，大家都会这么说，对对我知道！不过我写这篇日志就是为了保持清醒，对吧？那我就写下来。他问自己在哪里，呼吸很重，像是喘不过气，像是正被拖进引擎里。他听起来很害怕。他说他口渴。


我从没听过爸爸那样说话。也许只是我睡得不够。天啊，现在我要怎么办。也许我该把那东西打开看看。


也许是因为我心里不好受，因为我们卖掉了从 Vow 上那个巨大无翼家伙那里偷来的小鸟。它一直恶狠狠地瞪着我们。老天，它跑得可真快，我们当场就得撤。蠢蛋 Lucas 从那以后一直牙齿打战。我不会再那么做了。
他们让“我”把那只小鸟放到柜台上。我觉得我不该那么做。现在我知道他们为什么让我来做了……他们比我更心虚。懦夫。所以我当面告诉 Desmond：自己的脏活自己干。

他傻乎乎地问，心虚什么？就因为卖掉小鸟蛋！然后，我真不敢相信，他说这和你早餐吃的蛋没区别。我说它破壳出来看着我们，我不会吃那东西！它是活的。然后他说的话是：“它能搬废料吗？能帮我们完成配额吗？能提高效率和吞吐量、增强团队协同吗？能不能叭叭叭叭叭叭
blasbdalsbdabdalbalbdalbdlaslbdaldbalbsdlbadlbalbsdlbadlbalbsdlbadlbalsbdabldbasbalsbalbblBSLABALBBALBALBALBASLBASBABBLABSLDBAKDSJAFBSfkjhbaglsdsjbkabdA BLA BLA BLA BL AB LABL A BLA BLA BB LLABDLAB BLAL Abldblbdbd” 他那张肥厚的蠢嘴像公司电话里的声音一样不停翻出来。然后他长长吐了一口气，好像很满意，就回去干活了，像是他赢了辩论。我要杀了他！！Desmond，要不我把你也放到柜台上，就像我知道你们对 Rich 做的那样。那才叫团队协同。

我往通风口里倒了点葡萄汁。我太蠢了，不知道为什么这么做。也没倒多少。我大概只是觉得这不会伤到什么东西。

entries.source:
Date: October 13, 1968
This is Desmond. Sigurd is unable to write. But I feel the need to keep a record, and none of us are sleeping tonight. After the incident, he's practically catatonic. He says he heard his father's voice in the air intake vent under the charger several days ago; I wish he'd told us before the incident, but I'm liable to believe he's being honest at least to himself. In this state he'd be a danger to himself and others, so we've been reduced to a three-man crew--a hard blow I'm afraid we can't afford.

This is how Jess and Lucas recounted it. There was a scraping sound, of which they soon located the vent as the source. They took this as a sign of the ship needing maintenance and perhaps an oil change. Lucas went to grab the tools just to check. However before he returned, the vent burst with a chunky, red fluid, with what were almost surely bits of bone and hair, which spread across the floor, like the contents of a clogged toilet. Fully emptying the vent, cleaning out the ship, and eradicating the stench was a challenge I wouldn't wish on anyone, especially with Sigurd trying to stop us. Now the smell of bleach burning our nostrils is a relief.

Why? Why did it happen? I cannot reasonably entertain Sigurd's "explanation" that somehow his father was inside the ship. He has always been quite imaginative, not to mention his current state. I believe the crew before us--or the crew before that--is simply responsible for attempting to avoid a fine, and the method was to hide their mistake. The victim's remains have been dumped out, and we will never identify them.

It doesn't matter. As I stated, this is unsustainable. I have followed every step of the handbook. I have tried to make things work. I have maximized our efficiency. I have kept our morale in check. Now, even I am wringing my hands. It's like this job is just designed to break me! I've done everything right, I've done everything I can, and still, we would have to pull a miracle just to get back on track. The only course of action left is to do what I cannot. So maybe I will. 

I will hand in my letter of resignation personally. It’s time to see who we've been working for. No, Sigurd, this is not our real job. Our work has just begun. And there is no way out but further in.
entries.target:
日期：1968 年 10 月 13 日
我是 Desmond。Sigurd 无法写字。但我觉得必须留下记录，而且今晚我们没有一个人睡得着。事故之后，他几乎陷入紧张性木僵。他说几天前曾在充电器下面的进气通风口里听见他父亲的声音；我希望他在事故前告诉过我们，但我倾向于相信，至少在他自己看来，他说的是实话。以他现在的状态，他会对自己和他人构成危险，所以我们已经缩减成三人船员组。这是个沉重打击，恐怕我们承受不起。

Jess 和 Lucas 是这样复述的。当时有一阵刮擦声，他们很快确认声音来自通风口。他们以为这是飞船需要维护，也许要换油的信号。Lucas 去拿工具，只是想检查一下。但他回来前，通风口爆开，喷出一股浓稠的红色液体，里面几乎肯定混着骨头和毛发，像堵住的马桶内容物一样铺满地板。彻底清空通风口、清理飞船、消除恶臭，是我不愿任何人经历的折磨，尤其是 Sigurd 还试图阻止我们。现在，漂白剂烧灼鼻腔的气味反而让人安心。

为什么？为什么会发生？我不能合理接受 Sigurd 的“解释”，说他父亲不知怎么就在飞船里。他一直很有想象力，更不用说现在这种状态。我相信我们之前的船员组，或者再之前的船员组，只是为了逃避罚款，用这种方式隐藏了他们的错误。受害者遗骸已经被倒了出去，我们永远无法确认身份。

这并不重要。如我所说，这种状态无法维持。我遵守了手册上的每一步。我努力让一切运转。我最大化了我们的效率。我控制住了士气。现在，连我都开始焦虑。这份工作简直像是专门为了击垮我而设计的！我做对了所有事，我尽了一切努力，可即便如此，我们也必须靠奇迹才能回到正轨。剩下唯一的办法，就是去做我不能做的事。也许我会做。

我会亲手递交辞职信。是时候看看我们到底在为谁工作了。不，Sigurd，这不是我们真正的工作。我们的工作才刚刚开始。没有退路，只有继续深入。

\r
He's trying to come up with some big rebellion. Like what are we gonna go to the desk and shoot at it? sounds good Desmond, thats so great. he keeps talking like he's going on strike, which is a really cool word for sitting on your filthy fat butt and picking your nose and thinking youre so cool. I almost slipped on one of his papers walking in. i was carrying a rusty metal grinder and it probably would have chopped something off. i would've made sure to use it on him too before i ran out of blood. Sorry, thats kind of gross\r
\r
The whole wall is covered in his diagrams. At least he's still the wizard. Maybe he'll invent a big wand and teleport us out of here. And he thinks I'M crazy. That was Dad! I heard him and i thought i was crazy. But it WAS Dad. I saw it. Yeah i dont know how he was in the ship vent. iim gonna throw up. It doesnt make sense. you think im making that up? \r
Well I think YOU'RE crazy Desmond. what if i went and took all your papers and rip them apart,. oh my gosh. Dad is dead. We killed him.\r
\r
um.....writing didn't work. I'm just gonna get back to work. i just want to work.\r
entries.target:
是的，这里是 Sigurd，正在报告。今天我们工作了。
日期：10 月 15 日




好吧行。他们要我写。他们觉得我看起来很难过，以为把想法重新放进这台大机器里，我脸上就会露出大笑容。我很开心，我只是想工作，这就是我想要的一切。我只想工作，不想说话。这犯法吗？？？？不，当然我不想吃东西，因为我不饿。

他们大概真以为我会把我们炸掉还是怎样。与此同时他们却让 Desmond 偷懒。

他想搞什么大反抗。怎么，我们要走到柜台前朝它开枪吗？听起来不错，Desmond，真棒。他一直说得好像自己要罢工一样，罢工这个词听起来很酷，其实就是坐在你那肮脏的大屁股上挖鼻孔，还以为自己很厉害。我进来的时候差点踩到他一张纸滑倒。我当时拿着一个生锈的金属研磨机，可能会切掉点什么。在我流干血之前，我一定也会拿它对付他。抱歉，这有点恶心。

整面墙都贴满了他的图。至少他还是那个巫师。也许他会发明一根大魔杖，把我们传送出去。然后他还觉得我疯了。那就是爸爸！我听见他了，我以为自己疯了。但那就是爸爸。我看见了。对，我不知道他怎么会在飞船通风口里。我快吐了。这说不通。你觉得我在编？
好吧，我觉得你才疯了，Desmond。要是我过去把你所有纸都拿下来撕碎呢。哦我的天。爸爸死了。我们杀了他。

嗯……写东西没用。我还是回去工作吧。我只想工作。

entries.source: I havent felt like writing. no time. but last night I swear i heard dad talking to me from the vent, the one under the charger. i dont feel crazy. Man, thats what they all say, yea yea i know! Well, im writing this log to keep myself sane, right? so ill write about it. he was asking where he was, breathing really deep like he couldnt breath, like he was getting pulled into the engine. he sounded scared. he said he was thirsty
entries.target: 我一直不想写。没时间。但昨晚我发誓，我听见爸爸在和我说话，声音从充电器下面那个通风口里传出来。我不觉得自己疯了。好吧，大家都会这么说，对对我知道！不过我写这篇日志就是为了保持清醒，对吧？那我就写下来。他问自己在哪里，呼吸很重，像是喘不过气，像是正被拖进引擎里。他听起来很害怕。他说他口渴

entries.source: This is Desmond. Sigurd is unable to write. But I feel the need to keep a record, and none of us are sleeping tonight. After the incident, he's practically catatonic. He says he heard his father's voice in the air intake vent under the charger several days ago; I wish he'd told us before the incident, but I'm liable to believe he's being honest at least to himself. In this state he'd be a danger to himself and others, so we've been reduced to a three-man crew--a hard blow I'm afraid we can't afford.

entries.source: This is how Jess and Lucas recounted it. There was a scraping sound, of which they soon located the vent as the source. They took this as a sign of the ship needing maintenance and perhaps an oil change. Lucas went to grab the tools just to check. However before he returned, the vent burst with a chunky, red fluid, with what were almost surely bits of bone and hair, which spread across the floor, like the contents of a clogged toilet. Fully emptying the vent, cleaning out the ship, and eradicating the stench was a challenge I wouldn't wish on anyone, especially with Sigurd trying to stop us. Now the smell of bleach burning our nostrils is a relief.

entries.source: Why? Why did it happen? I cannot reasonably entertain Sigurd's "explanation" that somehow his father was inside the ship. He has always been quite imaginative, not to mention his current state. I believe the crew before us--or the crew before that--is simply responsible for attempting to avoid a fine, and the method was to hide their mistake. The victim's remains have been dumped out, and we will never identify them.

entries.source: It doesn't matter. As I stated, this is unsustainable. I have followed every step of the handbook. I have tried to make things work. I have maximized our efficiency. I have kept our morale in check. Now, even I am wringing my hands. It's like this job is just designed to break me! I've done everything right, I've done everything I can, and still, we would have to pull a miracle just to get back on track. The only course of action left is to do what I cannot. So maybe I will.

they had me on screen duty, and then they all came waddling back,, but Rich wasn't there, and they said they couldnt find him. Desmond said it turned his neck but he didnt see it. I wanted to find Rich even if he was dead, but they are cowards! their faces are blank like idiots, theres nothing moving in their stupid skulls, all they wanted to do is leave. they were going to leave me too if i went out. we all hated Rich but we didnt want this. this isnt worth it, its just not worth it. we got a pair of scissors, a box full of stamps and a bundle of cords to sell for nothing. its not wort h it, what does the company even want it for?


the date we last saw Rich is September 7, 1968

他们让我盯着屏幕，后来他们全都摇摇晃晃地回来了，可 Rich 不在。他们说找不到他。Desmond 说它转过脖子，但他没看见。我想去找 Rich，哪怕他已经死了，可他们都是懦夫！他们脸上一片空白，像傻子一样，愚蠢的脑袋里什么都没在动；他们只想离开。如果我出去，他们也会把我丢下。我们都讨厌 Rich，但我们不想变成这样。这不值得，真的不值得。我们拿到一把剪刀、一箱邮票和一捆电线，卖不了几个钱。根本不值。公司到底要这些东西干什么？
